# GitHub Repository Topics

This repository uses the following topics for improved discoverability on GitHub.

## Current Topics
- rust
- ubuntu  
- debian
- apt

## Recommended Additional Topics

To add these topics, go to the repository page on GitHub and click "About" → "Settings" (gear icon) → Add topics:

### Package Management
- package-manager
- ppa
- repository-management
- apt-repository

### System Administration  
- system-administration
- devops
- linux

### Development
- cli
- cli-tool
- command-line-tool
- automation

### Language/Platform
- rust-lang
- ubuntu-linux
- debian-linux

### Features
- launchpad
- gpg
- repository
- sources-list

## How to Add Topics

1. Navigate to https://github.com/maw629/rust-add-apt-repository
2. Click the gear icon (⚙️) next to "About" in the right sidebar
3. In the "Topics" field, add the recommended topics above
4. Click "Save changes"

Topics help users discover your project when searching GitHub by category or technology.
